paragraphs.text: Gnoll is a creature type based on the Dungeons & Dragons monster of the same name . They are a species of humanoid creatures that resemble human - hyena hybrids that are carnivorous and known for their warlike ways.

Only three Gnoll cards have been printed, plus one Arena -exclusive card. One is legendary , depicting the character Targ Nar ( card ), and two have the pack tactics ability. As a D&D -specific creature type, Gnolls aren't expected to show up in non- D&D sets.
